question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He said the cooperative will continue to invest ______ per its usual yearly rate.
solution:
The correct answer is '**as**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**as**'.
 
• After the blank '**per**' is used. Thus, '**as**' can be the only coherent answer.
 
• The phrase** 'as per'** means 'in accordance with'. (के अनुसार)
 
 
• *Example: made **as per** instructions...*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He said the cooperative will continue to invest **as** per its usual yearly rate.*
